explication: ACLPUB packages conference proceedings materials—PDFs, BibTeX, and optional files—for ACL Anthology ingestion. Its documented entry points are START and the command line; the repository also contains scripts and templates for producing proceedings-related outputs. Source excerpts are limited to a PDF overlay utility and a placeholder sanity check, so connections among the other scripts and templates are not inferred from names alone.
